# Stack & Ship

> Solo Founder Tools. Tested kits, free tools and guides for Next.js + Supabase + Stripe builders.

## Tools

- [Free Next.js + Supabase + Stripe Security Checker](https://edtrackai.github.io/checker): Free, MIT-licensed security checker for Next.js + Supabase + Stripe apps: 24 checks for leaked keys, RLS, Data API grants and webhooks.
- [OpenAI and Claude API cost calculator, per user per month](https://edtrackai.github.io/tools/ai-api-cost-calculator): Free OpenAI and Claude API cost calculator: estimate monthly token spend per user, with cached input, and see what a per-user dollar cap would hold.

## Products

- [Launch Audit: Supabase & Stripe Security Audit for Next.js](https://edtrackai.github.io/launch-audit): Run /audit before launch: 28 checks for leaked keys, RLS gaps, auth and Stripe webhooks, verified by an AI auditor with no Edit or Write tools.
- [Paid MCP Starter: Charge for Your MCP Server with Stripe](https://edtrackai.github.io/paid-mcp-starter): Next.js + Supabase template for a paid MCP server: API keys, free tier, Stripe usage billing, rate limits, usage dashboard. $49 plus VAT where applicable.
- [Ship It Bundle: AI Rules v2, Launch Audit & Solo Founder OS](https://edtrackai.github.io/ship-it-bundle): Build it carefully, audit it before launch, then run the business. AI Rules v2, Launch Audit and Solo Founder OS Pro in one checkout.
- [Guardrails Pack for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex CLI](https://edtrackai.github.io/guardrails): Hooks, permission presets and git guards for Next.js + Supabase + Stripe apps built with Claude Code, Cursor or Codex CLI.
- [Spend Caps Kit: Next.js + Supabase + Stripe | Stack & Ship](https://edtrackai.github.io/spend-caps-kit): Per-user rate limits, a monthly AI spend cap in dollars, and a Stripe checkout guard for Next.js + Supabase. Copy-paste TypeScript, 52 tests, one-off fee.
- [Better Auth + Drizzle Cursor rules for Next.js and Polar](https://edtrackai.github.io/stack-pack): Cursor rules for Better Auth, Drizzle, Next.js 16, and Polar, plus 6 skills, 3 Claude Code hooks, and a 20-check launch script. 247 tests pass.
- [AI Rules v2: Claude Code Hooks for Next.js + Supabase](https://edtrackai.github.io/ai-rules): Guardrail hooks designed to refuse .env reads, prod migrations and client-side Stripe keys, plus 18 skills and 6 subagents. $19 plus VAT where applicable.
- [Solo Founder OS: Notion Template for Solo Founders](https://edtrackai.github.io/solo-founder-os): A Notion workspace for solo founders: projects, tasks, revenue with MRR and VAT, expenses, subscriptions and monthly profit per product. Free Lite.
- [UK Sole Trader Self-Assessment Tracker 2026/27 | Sheets](https://edtrackai.github.io/uk-sole-trader-tracker): Spreadsheet for UK sole traders: income, expenses, mileage, use of home, income tax and Class 4 NI estimates, VAT and MTD threshold watch. 2026/27.

## Blog

- [How to Track Subscriptions in Notion (Free Template)](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/notion-subscription-tracker-template): A free Notion subscription tracker template: each tool's monthly cost, days to renewal, and a renewing-soon flag, so renewals don't catch you out.
- [Notion Income Tracker for Solo Founders (Free Build Guide)](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/notion-income-tracker-template): Build a Notion income tracker that logs every sale by source and product, nets out fees and refunds, and totals each month. Copy-paste formulas, free build guide.
- [Notion Expense Tracker for Solo Founders (Free Template)](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/notion-expense-tracker-template): Build a Notion expense tracker that tags each cost to a product, splits out VAT and recurring tools, and totals the month. Free step-by-step build inside.
- [Gemini API key reported as leaked? Rotate, cap, find the leak](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/gemini-api-key-reported-as-leaked): Got a “reported as leaked” Gemini API key or a sudden bill? Rotate the key, set budgets, scrub git history, and keep keys out of client code with these steps.
- [Codex desktop “Cannot serialize value” worktree error: fix](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/codex-desktop-new-worktree-chat-fix): Codex desktop 26.1016.51333 broke new worktree chats with “Cannot serialize value”. The fix reported in the issues, a workaround, and a git fallback.
- [Claude weekly limit reached? Why it burns fast + what to do](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/claude-code-weekly-limit-reached): Hit “weekly limit reached” in Claude Code mid-week? Check what drained it, what to do until the reset, and settings designed to make next week last longer.
- [Claude Code deleted my files: recover them, then guard against a repeat](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/claude-code-deleted-my-files): Claude Code, Codex or Cursor deleted your files? Try rewind, git and OS recovery first, then add permission rules and git guards designed to stop a repeat.
- [Better Auth + Polar in Next.js with Drizzle (Guide)](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/better-auth-polar-nextjs-drizzle): Wire the Better Auth Polar plugin into a Next.js app with Drizzle: schema, checkout, customer portal, webhooks and gating paid routes, with working code.
- [Supabase getSession vs getUser vs getClaims in Next.js](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/supabase-getsession-vs-getuser-vs-getclaims): Which Supabase auth method to trust on the server in Next.js: getClaims for pages, getUser for writes, and getSession never for authorisation. With code.
- [Prompt caching not working? OpenAI and Anthropic checks](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/prompt-caching-not-working-openai-anthropic-nextjs): Prompt caching not working? Check the OpenAI and Anthropic cache usage fields in a Next.js AI SDK route, common causes of misses and cached token pricing.
- [OpenAI and Anthropic spend limits per user in Next.js](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/openai-anthropic-spend-limit-per-user-nextjs): OpenAI and Anthropic cap spend per project or workspace, not per user. Add a per-user rate limit and monthly dollar cap in Next.js with Supabase.
- [OpenAI & Claude Count Tokens API: Check Before You Send](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/openai-anthropic-count-tokens-api-nextjs): Count tokens before you call OpenAI or Claude. Use the OpenAI count tokens API and Anthropic count_tokens in Next.js to check context fit and cost first.
- [OpenAI & Anthropic 429 Errors: Retry or Stop? (Next.js)](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/openai-anthropic-429-rate-limit-error-nextjs): OpenAI 429 too many requests or insufficient_quota? Anthropic 429 or 529? Read the error code, retry only what can clear, and stop wasted calls in Next.js.
- [Cursor Usage Limits: Weekly Pool, Resets and Legacy Plans](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/cursor-usage-limits-reset-weekly-pool): Hit your Cursor usage limit? New plans use a weekly pool; legacy Pro plans keep monthly pools. When each resets, how to check usage, what to do next.
- [Codex Credits: Cost, Usage Limit Resets and Spend Caps](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/codex-credits-cost-usage-limit-resets): Hit your Codex limit? How ChatGPT credits work, what a task can cost, how to check usage, redeem an earned reset and cap auto reload spend.
- [Claude 'temperature is deprecated for this model' Fix](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/claude-temperature-deprecated-400-nextjs): Claude Sonnet 5.5 or Haiku 5.5 returning 'temperature is deprecated for this model'? What's rejected, what still passes, and how to fix it in Next.js.
- [Claude Code: reduce token usage and make limits last](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/claude-code-reduce-token-usage-limits): Claude Code limits are a 5-hour window plus a weekly cap. Reduce token usage with /clear, model choice, lean CLAUDE.md, subagents and a tested status line.
- [Claude Code "Monthly Spend Limit" Error and Usage Credits](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/claude-code-monthly-spend-limit-usage-credits): Seeing "You've hit your monthly spend limit" in Claude Code? Whose limit it is, how to raise or wait it out, and what usage credits cost.
- [Codex usage limits: ChatGPT Pro 200 changes after 29 Oct](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/chatgpt-pro-200-codex-usage-limits): Grandfathered ChatGPT Pro 200 plans move to a lower Codex allowance after 29 Oct. What OpenAI's help pages say, and documented ways to make usage last.
- [Supabase RLS policies that pass review but still leak data](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/supabase-rls-policies-pass-review-leak-data): Two Supabase RLS policy shapes that look secure and still leak: auth.uid() is not null, and free credits keyed on raw emails. SQL to find and fix both.
- [Supabase Service Role Key Exposed? Check, Rotate, Prevent](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/supabase-service-role-key-exposed): How a Supabase service role or secret key leaks in Next.js apps, how to check your build and git history, how to rotate it, and how to stop it recurring.
- [Supabase Permission Denied for Table? Data API Grants Fix](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/supabase-permission-denied-for-table-data-api-grants): Supabase plans a 30 Oct 2026 change: new public tables need explicit grants for the Data API. SQL checks, fixes and an FAQ.
- [Subscription Audit for Indie Developers: Cut Tool Spend](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/subscription-audit-indie-developers): A 20-minute audit to list every tool you pay for, turn yearly plans into monthly costs and never miss a renewal. Notion formulas and a free template.
- [Stripe Webhook Signature Verification Failed? Next.js Fix](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/stripe-webhook-signature-verification-failed-nextjs): Fix Stripe's 'No signatures found matching the expected signature for payload' in Next.js App Router: raw body, the right secret, runtime and clock.
- [Notion Template for Indie Hackers: What to Look For](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/notion-template-for-indie-hackers): How to choose a Notion template for indie hacking: the databases that matter, the formulas worth having, red flags, and a free option to start with.
- [Track MRR and Profit per Product in Notion (Free Template)](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/notion-mrr-profit-tracker): Build a Notion system that calculates MRR and monthly profit for each product with relations, formulas and rollups. Step-by-step, with copy-paste formulas.
- [Security-Focused Cursor Rules: Next.js + Supabase + Stripe](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/cursor-rules-nextjs-supabase-stripe): Cursor rules (.mdc) and AGENTS.md guidance for Next.js 16, Supabase RLS and Stripe webhooks, with the mistake each rule prevents. Free sample included.
- [How to Charge for an MCP Server with Stripe Usage Billing](https://edtrackai.github.io/blog/charge-for-mcp-server-stripe-usage-billing): Bill per tool call on a remote MCP server: API keys, a free quota, Stripe Billing Meters with idempotent meter events, webhooks and rate limits.
